script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

A modern, open-concept office space with glass walls and potted plants. Employees type away on their laptops, chatting quietly among themselves. The sun pours in from large windows.

At the center of it all, PETER (30s, glasses, balding, dressed in a suit), the stern and stoic CEO, makes his way through the maze of desks, heading towards his office. He's always the first one in and the last one out.

INT. PETER'S OFFICE - DAY

Peter sits at his desk, staring intently at his computer screen. The room is filled with a faint hum of technology. He clicks through documents, his expression unreadable.

Suddenly, his assistant, AMELIA (20s, bright, energetic, wearing business casual), pops her head into the room, a stack of files in her arms.

AMELIA: (excited) Peter! Good news! The latest sales report shows a 20% increase in revenue.

PETER: (unimpressed) I see.

Amelia looks crestfallen for a moment before composing herself.

AMELIA: And, we've been nominated for a prestigious industry award!

This time, Peter's expression softens slightly.

PETER: That's impressive, Amelia. Keep me updated.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

In the bustling office, employees mill about, chatting and laughing. The mood is light and casual. Suddenly, the atmosphere shifts as everyone turns to look at the entrance.

RACHEL (30s, beautiful, confident, dressed in a red suit), the new COO, makes her grand entrance, her heels clicking against the hard floor. She strides confidently through the office, shaking hands and exchanging pleasantries.

INT. PETER'S OFFICE - NIGHT

Peter sits at his desk, staring at a photo of his family. He looks troubled, his mind preoccupied.

Ring. Ring.

He answers the phone, his expression turning serious.

PETER: (into phone) Yes, this is Peter.

A pause as he listens intently. His face darkens.

PETER: (angrily) How dare you! This is my company! I've built it from the ground up!

He slams down the phone, causing the photo to shake.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

The office is buzzing with excitement as the industry awards ceremony approaches. Peter stands before the employees, looking nervous.

PETER: (nervously) I want to thank each and every one of you for your hard work and dedication. We've come a long way, and I couldn't have done it without you.

Rachel walks up behind him, placing a hand on his shoulder.

RACHEL: (smiling) We make a great team, don't we, Peter?

He turns to look at her, a mixture of frustration and admiration in his eyes.

PETER: (resigned) Yes, I suppose we do.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY - NIGHT

The room is filled with the rich and powerful of the technology industry. Peter and Rachel stand together, dressed in their finest, accepting the award for Company of the Year. The crowd applauds as they pose for photos.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

Back in the office, Peter sits at his desk, staring at the award, lost in thought. Rachel enters, carrying a stack of reports.

RACHEL: (smiling) Congratulations, Peter. We did it.

He looks up at her, his eyes filled with determination.

PETER: Yes, we did. But this is just the beginning.

She nods in agreement, and they both get back to work.

FADE OUT.
